content.intro: Learn template context processors through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Template Context Processors matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines template context processors as part of django templates and dynamic pages. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
content_blocks.text: The source syllabus for this lesson names: What context processors do; Built-in context processors; Shared data across templates; Custom context processors; Performance and context design. Keep these distinct concepts together: know what each item does, when it applies, and what assumption must be verified in your project.
